data.rationale: The proposal follows the same overall sequence (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator, OpenTable, Notes, Mail) with essentially the right parameters. It omits the review score ≥8 hotel filter, the timeanddate Weather page, the "do not click Reserve/Book/Send" constraints, and the Discard step. It also hardcodes a 20:00 OpenTable time instead of taking the first available evening slot, and its email body and subject are vague, so a faithful automation would need guesswork.
